description.en: Anonymous song messages. Pick a track, write a note and a vibe, then share it — the recipient opens the link, the song plays, and your name never appears.
description.id: Pesan lagu anonim. Pilih sebuah lagu, tulis catatan beserta vibe-nya, lalu bagikan — penerima membuka tautannya, lagunya terdengar, dan namamu tak pernah muncul.
